title: Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Contracts per Customer: Open-Contract Limit
content:
**Credit Policy Manual — open-contract limit, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

**Clause.** A customer may hold at most 2 open pre-owned retail installment sale contracts at the same time. A contract counts as open in every status except paid in full, closed and charged off; a contract still pending funding counts. A booking that would exceed the cap is declined at funding review and is never booked; contracts held in other Kestrel products do not count toward this cap.

### Which contracts count

| Status of an existing Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract | Counts toward the limit of 2 |
|---|---|
| Pending funding | Yes |
| Active, assigned for repossession, repossessed, in deficiency | Yes |
| Paid in full, closed, charged off | No |

Contracts under other Kestrel products — a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease or any other — never count.

### Applying the limit (hypothetical cases)

- A customer already holding two open pre-owned contracts, one of them still pending funding, applies for a third: the booking would exceed the limit and is declined at funding review.
- A customer holding one open pre-owned contract and one pre-owned contract paid in full applies for another: only one contract counts, so the new booking stays within the limit.
- A customer holding one open pre-owned contract and two Kestrel leases applies for a second pre-owned contract: the leases do not count, so the limit is not exceeded.
